using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace RVFX.DestructionSystem
{
    // Small, code-authored icons. No font glyphs or version-dependent Unity icons.
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    internal static class RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI
    {
        internal enum Icon { First, Previous, Play, Pause, Next, Last, Reset }
        private static readonly Dictionary<Icon, Texture2D> Icons = new Dictionary<Icon, Texture2D>();
        private static readonly List<Texture2D> Textures = new List<Texture2D>();
        private static bool _dark;
        private static GUIStyle _card;
        internal static GUIStyle Card { get { EnsureStyles(); return _card; } }
        internal static GUIStyle Title, Section, Muted, Right, ButtonLabel, Button, Logo, Slider, Thumb;
        internal static readonly Color Accent = new Color(0.22f, 0.57f, 0.78f);

        static RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI()
        {
            AssemblyReloadEvents.beforeAssemblyReload += Clear;
            EditorApplication.quitting += Clear;
        }

        internal static void EnsureStyles()
        {
            if (_card != null && _dark == EditorGUIUtility.isProSkin) return;
            Clear();
            _dark = EditorGUIUtility.isProSkin;
            _card = new GUIStyle
            {
                padding = new RectOffset(10, 10, 8, 8),
                margin = new RectOffset(0, 0, 3, 4),
                normal = { background = Solid(_dark ? new Color(.19f, .20f, .21f) : new Color(.76f, .77f, .78f)) }
            };
            Title = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.boldLabel) { fontSize = 15 };
            Section = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.miniBoldLabel) { fontSize = 11 };
            Muted = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.miniLabel)
            {
                clipping = TextClipping.Clip,
                normal = { textColor = _dark ? new Color(.65f, .69f, .72f) : new Color(.29f, .32f, .35f) }
            };
            Right = new GUIStyle(Muted) { alignment = TextAnchor.MiddleRight };
            ButtonLabel = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.label) { alignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter, fontSize = 11 };
            Button = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.miniButton) { fixedHeight = 0 };
            Logo = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.boldLabel) { alignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter, fontSize = 11 };
            Slider = new GUIStyle
            {
                fixedHeight = 14,
                padding = new RectOffset(),
                margin = new RectOffset()
            };
            Thumb = new GUIStyle
            {
                fixedWidth = 8, fixedHeight = 14,
                normal = { background = Solid(Accent) },
                hover = { background = Solid(Accent * 1.15f) },
                active = { background = Solid(Accent) }
            };
        }

        internal static bool IconButton(Rect rect, Icon icon, string text, string tooltip, bool accent = false)
        {
            EnsureStyles();
            Color old = GUI.backgroundColor;
            if (accent) GUI.backgroundColor = new Color(.35f, .70f, 1f);
            bool clicked = GUI.Button(rect, new GUIContent("", tooltip), Button);
            GUI.backgroundColor = old;
            float textWidth = string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? 0 : ButtonLabel.CalcSize(new GUIContent(text)).x;
            float contentWidth = 14 + (textWidth > 0 ? 5 + textWidth : 0);
            float x = rect.center.x - contentWidth * .5f;
            Color tint = GUI.color;
            GUI.color = new Color(1, 1, 1, GUI.enabled ? 1 : .35f);
            GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(x, rect.center.y - 7, 14, 14), GetIcon(icon));
            GUI.color = tint;
            if (textWidth > 0) GUI.Label(new Rect(x + 19, rect.y, textWidth, rect.height), text, ButtonLabel);
            return clicked;
        }

        internal static Texture2D GetIcon(Icon icon)
        {
            if (Icons.TryGetValue(icon, out Texture2D texture) && texture != null) return texture;
            const int size = 56;
            var pixels = new Color[size * size];
            for (int y = 0; y < size; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < size; x++)
            {
                float coverage = 0;
                for (int sy = 0; sy < 2; sy++)
                for (int sx = 0; sx < 2; sx++)
                    if (Inside(icon, new Vector2((x + (sx + .5f) * .5f) * 16 / size,
                        16 - (y + (sy + .5f) * .5f) * 16 / size))) coverage += .25f;
                pixels[y * size + x] = new Color(.90f, .94f, .97f, coverage);
            }
            texture = new Texture2D(size, size, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false)
            {
                name = "RVFX Playback " + icon,
                hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave,
                filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear,
                wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp
            };
            texture.SetPixels(pixels);
            texture.Apply(false, true);
            Icons.Add(icon, texture);
            return texture;
        }

        private static bool Inside(Icon icon, Vector2 p)
        {
            switch (icon)
            {
                case Icon.Play: return Triangle(p, new Vector2(5, 3), new Vector2(13, 8), new Vector2(5, 13));
                case Icon.Pause: return new Rect(4, 3, 2.5f, 10).Contains(p) || new Rect(9.5f, 3, 2.5f, 10).Contains(p);
                case Icon.First:
                case Icon.Previous:
                    return Triangle(p, new Vector2(11, 3), new Vector2(5, 8), new Vector2(11, 13)) ||
                        (icon == Icon.First && new Rect(2, 3, 1.6f, 10).Contains(p));
                case Icon.Last:
                case Icon.Next:
                    return Triangle(p, new Vector2(5, 3), new Vector2(11, 8), new Vector2(5, 13)) ||
                        (icon == Icon.Last && new Rect(12.4f, 3, 1.6f, 10).Contains(p));
                default:
                    float distance = Vector2.Distance(p, new Vector2(8, 8));
                    bool arc = distance >= 4.3f && distance <= 5.8f && !(p.x < 5 && p.y < 6);
                    return arc || Triangle(p, new Vector2(2, 1.5f), new Vector2(2, 7), new Vector2(7, 6));
            }
        }

        private static bool Triangle(Vector2 p, Vector2 a, Vector2 b, Vector2 c)
        {
            float d1 = Cross(p - a, b - a), d2 = Cross(p - b, c - b), d3 = Cross(p - c, a - c);
            return !((d1 < 0 || d2 < 0 || d3 < 0) && (d1 > 0 || d2 > 0 || d3 > 0));
        }
        private static float Cross(Vector2 a, Vector2 b) => a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
        private static Texture2D Solid(Color color)
        {
            var texture = new Texture2D(1, 1) { hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave };
            texture.SetPixel(0, 0, color);
            texture.Apply(false, true);
            Textures.Add(texture);
            return texture;
        }
        private static void Clear()
        {
            foreach (Texture2D texture in Icons.Values) if (texture != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(texture);
            foreach (Texture2D texture in Textures) if (texture != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(texture);
            Icons.Clear();
            Textures.Clear();
            _card = null;
        }
    }
